missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Список' is masculine nominative, presented with 'вот'. 'Покупок' is a genitive plural modifier meaning of purchases.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Список' is the accusative object of 'составил'; inanimate masculine keeps the nominative form. 'Длинный' agrees, and 'дел' is genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В списке' uses the prepositional ending after 'в' to mean within the list. 'Твоего имени нет' states the name is absent.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Списка' is genitive after 'нет', and 'полного' agrees in the masculine genitive. The frame 'у меня нет' shows lacking the list.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Из списка' takes the genitive after 'из' to show removal from the list. 'Его' is the accusative object that was crossed out.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В список' uses the accusative after 'в' to show adding into the list. 'Молоко' is the accusative object of 'добавь'.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К списку' uses the dative after 'к' to mean toward the list. 'Ещё пункт' is the accusative object that was added.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Над списком' uses the instrumental after 'над' to mean working on the list. 'Этим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Списки' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' agrees and 'короткие' is the plural adjective, with 'слишком' intensifying.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Списков' is the genitive plural required after 'несколько'. 'Важных' agrees, and 'в книге' is the prepositional location.
